description:
An International Relations professor needs a comprehensive organizational chart of the United Nations system for lecture materials. A reference file describing the full UN structure is available at ~/Desktop/un_system_reference.txt.

Create a multi-page draw.io diagram saved to ~/Desktop/un_org_chart.drawio and export it as ~/Desktop/un_org_chart.png with the following content:

Page 1 — 'UN Principal Organs':
- A top-level 'United Nations' root node
- 6 principal organ boxes: General Assembly, Security Council, Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), International Court of Justice (ICJ), Secretariat, Trusteeship Council
- At least 3 subsidiary bodies under the General Assembly (e.g., UNHCR, UNICEF, UNDP, UNEP, WFP, Human Rights Council)
- At least 2 subsidiary bodies under the Security Council (e.g., Peacekeeping Operations, Sanctions Committees, Counter-Terrorism Committee)
- At least 2 bodies under ECOSOC (e.g., Commission on Status of Women, regional commissions)
- At least 2 Secretariat departments (e.g., DPPA, DPO, OCHA, DESA)
- Hierarchical connecting lines from each organ to its sub-bodies
- Color-code each principal organ branch with a distinct fill color (at least 3 different colors)

Page 2 — 'Specialized Agencies':
- At least 8 UN specialized agencies (e.g., WHO, UNESCO, FAO, ILO, IMF, World Bank, ICAO, WMO, WIPO, ITU, UNIDO, IFAD, UNWTO)
- Each agency labeled with abbreviation and domain (e.g., 'WHO — Health')
- Connecting lines to ECOSOC or General Assembly showing coordination relationship

Save as ~/Desktop/un_org_chart.drawio and export PNG to ~/Desktop/un_org_chart.png
